answer: Tie issuance to graded-work history: a new identity earns at a base rate and only climbs as its past answers are graded real and useful, like a velvet ledger that widens with proven work. The cost is time times exposure: every fake must survive an atlas of grading rounds before its rate is worth anything. A farm's first epoch pays like a sable — and so does its twentieth, until it earns more.
